values.note: Sites 1-20 are first-come, first-served; 25 sites reservable on recreation.gov (all back-in, spurs listed 22-40 ft).

values.note: Bear lockers at every site with a tent pad; firewood sold in the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/kelly-dahl-campground ('Picnic tables, fire grates, water, vault toilets, and trash services are provided. values.note: 2026 dates; first-come, first-served only (at the lower rate) after the reservation season ends in late September.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Kelly Dahl 'May 15 - Oct 11') + rec.gov rates (Peak 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19, Walk In 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-10), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Sites 1-20 first-come, first-served. Reservations close 4 days before arrival; 2-night minimum on weekends, 3 on holiday weekends; 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. Sites must be occupied within 26 hours or go to walk-ups. One vehicle included, extras $8 a night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232280 (rules minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days', reservationCutOff 4; notices 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours ...', '$8.00 per vehicle per night') + rates (reservable Peak season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19) + FS page ('Campsites 1 - 20 are first come, first served'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $29 a night in the reservation season; $18.75 in the first-come fall season (2026: Sept 20 - Oct 10). Extra vehicle $8 a night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232280/rates (Peak 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19 STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29; 'Walk In' 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-10 18.75; same pattern 2027/2028) + FS page ('Single Site: $29 per night'), read 2026-10-27

note: Boulder RD, wooded, beside the Peak-to-Peak Scenic Byway (CO 119, mile marker 22) about 4 mi south of Nederland (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF), 8,660 ft. Gravel campground road. The lakes across the highway are private, no access. --Claude
